The purpose

I create a practical system of tokens, components, variants and documentation that can grow with a product.

How I approach it

Reusable components and shared foundations that help teams build with consistency.

I begin by clarifying the audience, scope and constraints, then work collaboratively through the decisions that matter most.

What you can expect

  • Colour and type tokens
  • Component library
  • Variants and states
  • Usage guidance
  • Developer collaboration

Working together

The scope depends on the product and its stage. I can discuss a focused piece of work or a broader product design engagement.
